description: Provision an AWS Documentdb DBSubnetGroup via the ACK documentdb controller. Fields mirror the documentdb.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 DBSubnetGroup spec.

description.description: The description for the subnet group.

name.description:
The name for the subnet group. This value is stored as a lowercase string.

Constraints: Must contain no more than 255 letters, numbers, periods, underscores,
spaces, or hyphens. Must not be default.

Example: mySubnetgroup

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

subnetIDs.description: The Amazon EC2 subnet IDs for the subnet group.

items.description:
AWSResourceReferenceWrapper provides a wrapper around *AWSResourceReference
type to provide more user friendly syntax for references using 'from' field
Ex:
APIIDRef:

	from:
	  name: my-api

from.description:
AWSResourceReference provides all the values necessary to reference another
k8s resource for finding the identifier(Id/ARN/Name)

tags.description: The tags to be assigned to the subnet group.

items.description:
Metadata assigned to an Amazon DocumentDB resource consisting of a key-value
pair.
